"""The unsigned review a review-only cloud session returns, and its strict parse.

Shared by the cloud placement node (which reads the ended session's final message and
decides how the lane closes) and the agent review cloud rung (which renders the
review-only brief and turns the parsed review into one voter's vote), so neither node
imports the other's package.

The session writes one review in the v2 compact verdict format of the Hostile Reviewer
(OMN-20910; ``{"v", "f": [{"c", "p", "l", "s", "y", "n"}], "more", "done"}``) after a
marker line naming the head it reviewed. This module keeps its own strict view of that
wire shape, as the response parser does, and never salvages a reply that does not fit:
a missing marker, a head that is not the one requested, JSON that does not decode, a
field the shape does not have (a signature included), ``more: true`` or ``done``
absent is a refusal with a typed reason, never a shorter review.

The review is unsigned by construction: the dispatch node signs the receipt that counts
it. A session never holds a signing key.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from collections.abc import Iterator
from enum import StrEnum
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, ValidationError

REVIEW_ONLY_KIND = "review-only"
"""The ``Lane kind:`` of a review-only lane: it reviews a head and leaves no pull request."""

REVIEW_MARKER = "ONEX-AGENT-REVIEW"
"""The line ``ONEX-AGENT-REVIEW head=<40 hex>`` that opens the review in the final message."""

REVIEW_HEAD_PREFIX = "Review head:"
"""The brief's column-zero line naming the exact head the session must review."""

REVIEW_FILE = "/tmp/onex-agent-review.txt"
"""Where the session also writes the review, outside its checkout, so it is never pushed."""

FINAL_TEXT_MAX = 200_000
"""The longest final message the parse reads; a longer one is refused, never cut."""

_SHA = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{40}")
_MARKER_LINE = re.compile(rf"^{REVIEW_MARKER} head=(\S*)[ \t]*$", re.MULTILINE)
_HEAD_LINE = re.compile(rf"{re.escape(REVIEW_HEAD_PREFIX)}[ \t]*(\S*)[ \t]*")
_FENCE = re.compile(r"^[ \t]*(```|~~~)[A-Za-z0-9_-]*[ \t]*$", re.MULTILINE)

SEVERITY_WORDS: dict[str, str] = {
    "C": "critical",
    "M": "major",
    "m": "minor",
    "n": "nit",
}

def _column_zero(text: str) -> Iterator[str]:
    """Lines outside fenced blocks, so a quoted example is never read as metadata."""
    fence: str | None = None
    for line in text.splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith(("```", "~~~")):
            marker = stripped[:3]
            fence = marker if fence is None else (None if fence == marker else fence)
            continue
        if fence is None:
            yield line


def review_head(brief: str) -> str | None:
    """The head the brief asks the session to review (its first column-zero ``Review head:`` line), or None."""
    for line in _column_zero(brief):
        found = _HEAD_LINE.fullmatch(line)
        if found:
            head = found.group(1).lower()
            return head if _SHA.fullmatch(head) else None
    return None


def _refused(
    reason: EnumCloudReviewRefusal, detail: str = ""
) -> ModelCloudReviewRefused:
    return ModelCloudReviewRefused(reason=reason, detail=detail)


def parse_cloud_review(
    text: str,
    expected_head: str | None,
    source: Literal["final_message", "review_file"] = "final_message",

    Error details name the rule that failed and never echo the reply's text."""
    if not text.strip():
        return _refused(EnumCloudReviewRefusal.NO_TEXT)
    if len(text) > FINAL_TEXT_MAX:
        return _refused(EnumCloudReviewRefusal.TOO_LONG, f"over {FINAL_TEXT_MAX} chars")
    markers = list(_MARKER_LINE.finditer(text))
    if not markers:
        return _refused(EnumCloudReviewRefusal.NO_MARKER, f"no {REVIEW_MARKER} line")
    last = markers[-1]
    head = last.group(1).lower()
    if not _SHA.fullmatch(head):
        return _refused(EnumCloudReviewRefusal.BAD_HEAD, "head is not 40 hex")
    if expected_head is not None and head != expected_head.lower():
        return _refused(
            EnumCloudReviewRefusal.HEAD_DIFFERS, "the review names another head"
        )
    body = _FENCE.sub("", text[last.end() :]).strip()
    try:
        payload, _end = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(body)
    except ValueError:
        return _refused(
            EnumCloudReviewRefusal.NO_JSON, "no JSON object after the marker"

    if verdict.more:
        return _refused(
            EnumCloudReviewRefusal.MORE, "the reviewer had more findings than it listed"
        )
    return ModelCloudReview(
        head_sha=head,
        catalog_version=verdict.v,
        findings=tuple(
            ModelCloudReviewFinding(
                path=item.p,
                line=item.line,
                severity=SEVERITY_WORDS[item.s],
                claim=" ".join(
                    part for part in (item.c, item.y or "", item.n or "") if part

```python
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 OmniNode.ai Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""The savings baseline when the caller named no session model.

``resolve_baseline_model`` takes the session model first. Without one, the
baseline is the configured ``pricing.baseline_model`` (the overlay, then the
store), then the model the developer has used most in the history the caller
passes, and only with none of those the fixed default. The history is a
mapping of model id to use count; a blank id or a count below one is not use.
A tie goes to the lowest model id, so the same history always names the same
baseline.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Mapping
from typing import Literal

__all__ = ["BaselineSelectionCase", "configured_or_most_used"]

#: How a run's savings baseline was chosen; the receipt's ``baseline_source``.
BaselineSelectionCase = Literal[
    "session_model", "overlay", "store", "most_used", "fixed_default"
]


def _configured(config: object) -> str | None:
    if not isinstance(config, dict):
        return None
    pricing_config = config.get("pricing")
    if not isinstance(pricing_config, dict):
        return None
    candidate = pricing_config.get("baseline_model")
    if isinstance(candidate, str) and candidate.strip():
        return candidate.strip()
    return None


def _most_used(history: Mapping[str, int] | None) -> str | None:
    counts = {
        model.strip(): count
        for model, count in (history or {}).items()
        if isinstance(model, str) and model.strip() and count >= 1
    }
    if not counts:
        return None
    return min(counts, key=lambda model: (-counts[model], model))


def configured_or_most_used(
    overlay: object, store: object, history: Mapping[str, int] | None
) -> tuple[str, BaselineSelectionCase] | None:
    """The baseline and its case, or None when the fixed default applies."""
    for config, case in ((overlay, "overlay"), (store, "store")):
        model = _configured(config)
        if model is not None:
            return model, "overlay" if case == "overlay" else "store"
    most_used = _most_used(history)
    return (most_used, "most_used") if most_used is not None else None
```

```python
"""The caller's protocol table: which protocols exist and which node declares which."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Self

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, model_validator

from omnimarket.models.binding_conformance.model_binding_node_row import (
    ModelBindingNodeRow,
)
from omnimarket.models.binding_conformance.model_binding_protocol import (
    ModelBindingProtocol,

class ModelBindingProtocolTable(BaseModel):
    """Data supplied by the caller; the node holds no row and no protocol of its own."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    protocols: tuple[ModelBindingProtocol, ...]
    rows: tuple[ModelBindingNodeRow, ...]

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _consistent(self) -> Self:
        codes = [p.code for p in self.protocols]
        refs = [p.protocol for p in self.protocols]
        if len(set(codes)) != len(codes):
            raise ValueError("a protocol code appears twice in the table")
        if len(set(refs)) != len(refs):
            raise ValueError("a protocol import path appears twice in the table")
        nodes = [r.node for r in self.rows]
        if len(set(nodes)) != len(nodes):
            raise ValueError("a node has two rows in the table")
        for row in self.rows:
            unknown = sorted(set(row.protocols) - set(codes))
            if unknown:
                raise ValueError(f"row of {row.node} names unknown protocol {unknown}")
            if len(set(row.protocols)) != len(row.protocols):
                raise ValueError(f"row of {row.node} repeats a protocol")
        return self
```

```python
never a value. Values sit in ``~/.onex/credentials.json`` (mode 0600), the same
split ``onex auth login`` and ``onex auth lane-login`` already use. Nothing about
any deployment's store is committed to this package.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from collections.abc import Mapping

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, ValidationError, field_validator

from omnimarket.models.secret_store.plain_http_rule import validate_plain_http_hosts

#: The block name inside ``~/.onex/config.yaml``. The hook producer in
#: omniclaude reads the same block, with its own writer identity keys.
CAPTURED_SECRET_STORE_BLOCK = "captured_secret_store"


class ModelCapturedSecretStoreOverlay(BaseModel):
    """Store addressing for the captured namespace and the two identities.

    The WRITER (the content-capture producer) may only create secrets in the
    namespace; the READER (a consumer) may only read them. Each side uses only
    its own keys: a reader never authenticates as the writer, and the reverse.
    Every ``*_ref`` names an entry in ``credentials.json``, never a value.
    Unknown keys are ignored so the block can grow without breaking a reader.
    """

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="ignore")

    #: Which store adapter node_secret_store_effect uses for this namespace.
    #: The writer requires it; the reader does not read it yet.
    provider: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1)
    infisical_addr: str = Field(min_length=1, pattern=r"^https?://")
    #: Hosts the store may be reached at over plain http, beside loopback. The
    #: same rule as the secret_store block's key of this name (OMN-23193).
    plain_http_hosts: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    project_id: uuid.UUID
    environment_slug: str = Field(min_length=1)
    secret_path: str = Field(min_length=1, pattern=r"^/")
    #: The reader's machine-identity client id. Not a secret.
    reader_client_id: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1)
    #: The key the reader's client secret is filed under in credentials.json.
    reader_client_secret_ref: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1)
    #: The writer's machine-identity client id. Not a secret.
    writer_client_id: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1)
    #: The key the writer's client secret is filed under in credentials.json.
    writer_client_secret_ref: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1)
    #: The key the per-deployment reference key is filed under. The reference
    #: digest is HMAC-SHA256 of a value under it, so equal values deduplicate
    #: and the bus never carries an unsalted hash of a low-entropy secret.
    reference_key_ref: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1)

    @field_validator("plain_http_hosts")
    @classmethod
    def _hosts_parse(cls, value: tuple[str, ...]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        return validate_plain_http_hosts(value)


def load_captured_secret_store_overlay(
    config: Mapping[str, object], *, source: str = "config.yaml"
) -> ModelCapturedSecretStoreOverlay:
    """Read the block out of a parsed config, naming every bad key (never a value).

    Raises:
        ValueError: the block is absent, not a mapping, or missing a key.
    """
    block = config.get(CAPTURED_SECRET_STORE_BLOCK)
    if not isinstance(block, Mapping):
        raise ValueError(
            f"{source} has no '{CAPTURED_SECRET_STORE_BLOCK}' block; this machine "
            "is not configured to reach the captured-secret store"
        )
    try:
        return ModelCapturedSecretStoreOverlay.model_validate(dict(block))
    except ValidationError as exc:
        fields = sorted({str(err["loc"][0]) for err in exc.errors() if err["loc"]})
        raise ValueError(
            f"{source} block '{CAPTURED_SECRET_STORE_BLOCK}' is missing or "
            f"malformed: {fields}"
        ) from None


__all__ = [
    "CAPTURED_SECRET_STORE_BLOCK",
    "ModelCapturedSecretStoreOverlay",
    "load_captured_secret_store_overlay",
]
```

```python
def ci_run_failed_event_id(
    repo: str, pr_number: int, head_sha: str, checks: Iterable[str]
) -> str:
    identity = f"{repo}\n{pr_number}\n{head_sha}\n" + "\n".join(sorted(set(checks)))
    return hashlib.sha256(identity.encode()).hexdigest()


# Claim identities. The decision and owner claims are rows of the
# pr_lifecycle_ledger_entries projection keyed by these correlation ids, so the
# handler that reads a claim and the reducer that writes it share one spelling.
def ci_red_decision_correlation_id(decision_key: str) -> UUID:
    return uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, "onex:ci-red-decision:" + decision_key)


def ci_red_owner_correlation_id(owner_key: str) -> UUID:
    return uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, "onex:ci-red-owner:" + owner_key)


def ci_red_owner_run_id(owner_key: str) -> str:
    return "ci-red-" + hashlib.sha256(owner_key.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]


def ci_red_cause_key(slug: str, check: str) -> str:
    """Check-level cause key, used for a red whose annotations are unread."""
    return f"cause:{slug}:{hashlib.sha256(check.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]}"


# The owner claim is a lease. Its writer (node_pr_lifecycle_state_reducer) stamps
# the expiry, the row's next_check_at, from the TTL its contract declares; an owner
# read counts a claim only before that expiry. So an owner that never closes, as a
# lane whose TERMINAL the ledger refused, stops owning its PRs at the TTL.
def ci_red_owner_claim_ttl(block: object) -> timedelta:
    """The contract's ``owner_claim_lease`` block; a missing or unknown TTL is refused."""
    if not isinstance(block, dict) or set(block) != {"ttl_seconds"}:
        raise ValueError(
            "owner_claim_lease must declare exactly ttl_seconds, got "
            f"{sorted(block) if isinstance(block, dict) else type(block).__name__}"
        )
    ttl = block["ttl_seconds"]
    if type(ttl) is not int or ttl <= 0:
        raise ValueError(
            f"owner_claim_lease.ttl_seconds must be a positive integer, got {ttl!r}"
        )
    return timedelta(seconds=ttl)


def ci_red_claim_holds(lease_expires_at: object, now: datetime) -> bool:
    """True while an owner claim's lease (its row's next_check_at) has not expired.

    Raises ValueError for an expiry that is not a timezone-aware time: an unknown
    lease is unread, never a claim held or released.
    """
    expires = (
        lease_expires_at
        if isinstance(lease_expires_at, datetime)
        else datetime.fromisoformat(str(lease_expires_at))
    )
    if expires.tzinfo is None:
        raise ValueError(f"lease expiry has no timezone: {lease_expires_at!r}")
    return now < expires

        check_run_ids={
            run.check: run.run_id for run in event.failing_runs if run.run_id
```

```python
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""Token prices and the monthly cycle of the Claude review key budget (OMN-20967).

The input and output prices come from the omnibase_infra pricing manifest, the
one pricing authority. The manifest carries no cache prices, so a cache write
and a cache read are priced as multiples of the input price, the multiples
being contract config of the budget node. Money is ``Decimal`` throughout.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import calendar
from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal

from omnibase_infra.models.pricing.model_pricing_table import ModelPricingTable
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from omnimarket.models.claude_review_budget.model_claude_review_usage import (
    ModelClaudeReviewUsage,
)

_PER_1K_TOKENS = Decimal(1000)


class ModelClaudeReviewTokenPrices(BaseModel):
    """USD per token of one model, for each of the four usage counts."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    model_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    input_usd: Decimal = Field(..., ge=0)
    cache_write_usd: Decimal = Field(..., ge=0)
    cache_write_1h_usd: Decimal = Field(..., ge=0)
    cache_read_usd: Decimal = Field(..., ge=0)
    output_usd: Decimal = Field(..., ge=0)
    source: str = Field(..., description="Manifest source and effective date.")

    def cost_of(self, usage: ModelClaudeReviewUsage) -> Decimal:
        """What one call spent: each usage count times its price."""
        return (
            usage.input_tokens * self.input_usd
            + usage.cache_creation_input_tokens * self.cache_write_usd
            + usage.cache_creation_1h_input_tokens
            * (self.cache_write_1h_usd - self.cache_write_usd)
            + usage.cache_read_input_tokens * self.cache_read_usd
            + usage.output_tokens * self.output_usd
        )

    def worst_case(self, *, prompt_tokens: int, max_tokens: int) -> Decimal:
        """The most a call can cost: the prompt uncached and the output at ``max_tokens``."""
        return prompt_tokens * self.input_usd + max_tokens * self.output_usd


def prices_from_manifest(
    table: ModelPricingTable,
    model_id: str,
    *,
    cache_write_input_multiplier: Decimal,
    cache_read_input_multiplier: Decimal,
    cache_write_1h_input_multiplier: Decimal = Decimal("2"),
) -> ModelClaudeReviewTokenPrices | None:
    """The model's per-token prices, or None when the manifest does not carry it."""
    entry = table.get_entry(model_id)
    if entry is None:
        return None
    input_usd = Decimal(str(entry.input_cost_per_1k)) / _PER_1K_TOKENS
    return ModelClaudeReviewTokenPrices(
        model_id=model_id,
        input_usd=input_usd,
        cache_write_usd=input_usd * cache_write_input_multiplier,
        cache_write_1h_usd=input_usd * cache_write_1h_input_multiplier,
        cache_read_usd=input_usd * cache_read_input_multiplier,
        output_usd=Decimal(str(entry.output_cost_per_1k)) / _PER_1K_TOKENS,
        source=f"{entry.source}, effective {entry.effective_date}",
    )


def _add_months(anchor: datetime, months: int) -> datetime:
    """``anchor`` moved ``months`` calendar months on, the day clamped to the month's end."""
    index = anchor.month - 1 + months
    year, month = anchor.year + index // 12, index % 12 + 1
    day = min(anchor.day, calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1])
    return anchor.replace(year=year, month=month, day=day)


def cycle_start(anchor: datetime, as_of: datetime, cycle_months: int) -> datetime:
    """The start of the cycle ``as_of`` falls in, cycles running every ``cycle_months`` from ``anchor``.

    Each start is computed from the anchor, never from the previous start, so
    an anchor on the 31st stays on the 31st wherever the month has one.
    """
    if as_of < anchor:
        raise ValueError(f"as_of {as_of.isoformat()} is before the cycle anchor")
    elapsed = (as_of.year - anchor.year) * 12 + as_of.month - anchor.month
    n = elapsed // cycle_months
    start = _add_months(anchor, n * cycle_months)
    while start > as_of:
        n -= 1
        start = _add_months(anchor, n * cycle_months)
    return start


def cycle_end(anchor: datetime, as_of: datetime, cycle_months: int) -> datetime:
    """Next cycle boundary, computed from the original anchor even after day clamping."""
    started = cycle_start(anchor, as_of, cycle_months)
    months = (started.year - anchor.year) * 12 + started.month - anchor.month
    return _add_months(anchor, months + cycle_months)
```

```python
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""How the orchestrator answers an additive call: a client verdict (OMN-22016, plan task TC.11).

A Claude Code hook that asks for a package is answered with the action that ends its
receipt-mode wait and the invocation id that joins the reply to it. A profile the server-side
list does not enable is never built and is answered ``none``; a build that fails is answered
``none`` too, so the hook injects nothing. An enabled profile's package is answered ``inject``
with the sha256 of the text it carries, which the hook checks before it prints.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
from collections.abc import Callable, Collection

from omnimarket.models.claude_code_binding import EnumClientVerdictAction
from omnimarket.models.context_pack_orchestrator import (
    EnumContextPackOrchestratorStatus,
    ModelContextPackBuilt,
    ModelContextPackCommand,
)


def answer_additive(
    command: ModelContextPackCommand,
    *,
    enabled: Collection[str],
    build: Callable[[ModelContextPackCommand], ModelContextPackBuilt],
) -> ModelContextPackBuilt:
    """Answer one additive call; ``build`` is the ordinary build of the same command."""
    request = command.request
    if request.profile_name not in enabled:
        return ModelContextPackBuilt(
            status=EnumContextPackOrchestratorStatus.NOT_ENABLED,
            profile_name=request.profile_name,
            action=EnumClientVerdictAction.NONE,
            invocation_id=request.invocation_id,
        )
    built = build(command)
    if built.status is not EnumContextPackOrchestratorStatus.OK:
        return built.model_copy(
            update={
                "action": EnumClientVerdictAction.NONE,
                "invocation_id": request.invocation_id,
            }
        )
    text = "\n\n".join(message.text for message in built.messages)
    return built.model_copy(
        update={
            "action": EnumClientVerdictAction.INJECT,
            "invocation_id": request.invocation_id,
            "text": text,
            "package_sha256": hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
        }
    )
```

```python
``enabled_additive_profiles`` in the orchestrator contract names the additive profiles whose
Claude Code rows are answered with a package. It ships empty: every additive call is answered

``PROMOTABLE_ADDITIVE_PROFILES`` after its measured p95 is within its 500 ms budget.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

import yaml

from omnimarket.models.claude_code_binding import ADDITIVE_BUDGET_CAPS_MS

#: Additive profiles a data PR may enable now; TC.13 promotes ``per_prompt`` into this set.
PROMOTABLE_ADDITIVE_PROFILES: frozenset[str] = frozenset(
    {"session_start", "agent_spawn"}
)

CONTRACT_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "contract.yaml"


def load_enabled_additive_profiles(
    contract_path: Path = CONTRACT_PATH,
) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    """The contract's list, each name an unrepeated promotable additive profile; absent is empty."""
    contract = yaml.safe_load(contract_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(contract, Mapping):
        raise ValueError("The orchestrator contract must be a mapping")
    names = contract.get("enabled_additive_profiles", [])
    if not isinstance(names, list) or not all(isinstance(n, str) for n in names):
        raise ValueError("enabled_additive_profiles must be a list of profile names")
    if len(set(names)) != len(names):
        raise ValueError("enabled_additive_profiles repeats a profile")
    for name in names:
        if name not in ADDITIVE_BUDGET_CAPS_MS:
            raise ValueError(f"{name!r} is not an additive profile")
        if name not in PROMOTABLE_ADDITIVE_PROFILES:
            raise ValueError(f"{name!r} cannot be enabled before its promotion (TC.13)")
    return tuple(names)
```

```python
    ordered = profile.factor_precedence or (
        profile.required_factors + profile.optional_factors
    )
    return {factor: index for index, factor in enumerate(ordered)}


def _session_scopes(request: ModelContextPackRequest) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    scopes: list[str] = []
    # The session source reads exactly one mode scope: case: (pinned) or session: (live).
    if request.mode is EnumContextPackMode.PINNED:
        scopes.append(f"case:{request.manifest_case}")
    elif request.session_id is not None:
        scopes.append(f"session:{request.session_id}")
    if request.newest_turn is not None:
        scopes.append(f"newest_turn:{request.newest_turn}")
    if request.session_barrier is not None:
        scopes.append(f"session_barrier:{request.session_barrier}")
    return tuple(scopes)


def _failed(
    request: ModelContextPackRequest,
    failure_class: EnumContextPackFailure,
    *errors: str,
    profile: ModelContextProfile | None = None,
    profile_content_hash: str | None = None,
    tiers: tuple[ModelContextPackTierStatus, ...] = (),
) -> ModelContextPackBuilt:
    return ModelContextPackBuilt(
        status=EnumContextPackOrchestratorStatus.FAILED,
        profile_name=request.profile_name,
        profile_version=profile.profile_version if profile is not None else None,
        profile_content_hash=profile_content_hash,
        tier_statuses=tiers,
        failure_class=failure_class,
        errors=errors,
        terminal_failure_cause=failure_class,
    )


def _ruling_ref(entry: ModelContextSourceEntry) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
    head = _ROW_HEAD.match(entry.text)
    lane = _ROW_LANE.search(entry.text)
    return (
        head.group("ts") if head else None,
        lane.group("lane") if lane else None,
    )


def _source_identity(source: ProtocolContextTierSource) -> str:
    contract_hash = getattr(source, "contract_hash", None)
    if isinstance(contract_hash, str) and contract_hash:
        return contract_hash
    kind = type(source)
    return f"{kind.__module__}.{kind.__qualname__}"


class HandlerContextPackOrchestrator:
    """Resolve, read every tier through its source, build and render one context package."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        sources: Mapping[EnumContextFactor, ProtocolContextTierSource] | None = None,
        *,
        profile_resolver: HandlerContextProfileResolver | None = None,
        builder: HandlerContextPackBuilder | None = None,
        renderer: HandlerContextPackRender | None = None,
        task_kind_rules: HandlerContextTaskKindRules | None = None,
        implementation_identity: Callable[[], Mapping[str, str]] | None = None,
        render_contract_version: str = RENDER_CONTRACT_VERSION,
        clock: Callable[[], float] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._sources = {} if sources is None else dict(sources)
        self._resolver, self._builder, self._renderer, self._task_kind_rules = (
            resolve_parts(profile_resolver, builder, renderer, task_kind_rules)
        )
        self._implementation_identity = (
            implementation_identity or default_implementation_identity
        )
        self._render_contract_version = render_contract_version
        self._clock = clock if clock is not None else time.perf_counter

    def handle(self, command: ModelContextPackCommand) -> ModelContextPackBuilt:
        request = command.request
        resolved = self._resolver.handle(
            ModelContextProfileResolveRequest(profile_name=request.profile_name)
        )
        if (
            resolved.status is not EnumContextProfileResolveStatus.OK
            or resolved.profile is None
            or resolved.profile_content_hash is None
        ):
            return _failed(
                request,
                resolved.failure_class or EnumContextPackFailure.PROFILE_NOT_FOUND,
                *resolved.errors,
            )
        profile = resolved.profile
        content_hash = resolved.profile_content_hash
        if request.token_budget_override is not None:
            if request.token_budget_override > profile.token_budget:
                return _failed(
                    request,
                    EnumContextPackFailure.INVALID_PROFILE,
                    f"token_budget_override {request.token_budget_override} exceeds "
                    f"the profile budget {profile.token_budget}; it may only lower it",
                    profile=profile,
                    profile_content_hash=content_hash,
                )
            profile = profile.model_copy(
                update={"token_budget": request.token_budget_override}
            )

        evaluated = self._task_kind_rules.handle(
            ModelContextTaskKindRulesRequest(
                profile_name=request.profile_name,
                profile=profile,
                caller_scope=request.caller_scope,
            )
        )
        if evaluated.status is not EnumContextTaskKindRulesStatus.OK:
            return _failed(
                request,
                EnumContextPackFailure.INVALID_PROFILE,
                evaluated.error or "task-kind rules could not be evaluated",
                profile=profile,
                profile_content_hash=content_hash,
            )
        task_kind = evaluated.task_kind if profile.task_kind_rules else None
        admitted = frozenset(evaluated.admitted_factors)
        required = set(profile.required_factors)
        session_scopes = _session_scopes(request)
        default_revision = request.session_barrier or request.newest_turn or "head"

        reads: list[
            tuple[EnumContextFactor, ModelContextSourceResult, float | None]
        ] = []
        for factor in _selected_factors(profile, admitted):
            source = self._sources.get(factor)
            if source is None:
                reads.append(
                    (
                        factor,
                        ModelContextSourceResult(
                            status=EnumContextSourceStatus.UNAVAILABLE
                        ),
                        None,
                    )
                )
                continue
            source_request = ModelContextSourceRequest(
                factor=factor,
                scopes=(*profile.scopes, *session_scopes),
                task_kind=task_kind,
                caller_scope=request.caller_scope,
                access=command.access,
                revision=request.tier_revisions.get(factor, default_revision),
            )
            started = self._clock()
            try:
                try:
                    answer = source.handle(source_request)
                finally:
                    elapsed_ms = (self._clock() - started) * 1000.0
            except Exception as exc:  # a source failure is a tier status, never a crash
                answer = ModelContextSourceResult.error(
                    EnumContextSourceErrorCode.INVALID_RESPONSE,
                    f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}",
                )
            reads.append((factor, answer, elapsed_ms))

        tiers: list[ModelContextPackTierStatus] = []
        entries_by_factor: dict[
            EnumContextFactor, tuple[ModelContextSourceEntry, ...]
        ] = {}
        missing: list[EnumContextFactor] = []
        for factor, answer, read_ms in reads:
            entries = tuple(e for e in answer.entries if e.factor is factor and e.text)
            usable = answer.status is EnumContextSourceStatus.RESOLVED and bool(entries)
            if usable:
                entries_by_factor[factor] = entries
            elif fails_build(profile, factor, answer):
                missing.append(factor)
            tiers.append(
                ModelContextPackTierStatus(
                    factor=factor,
                    required=factor in required,
                    status=answer.status,
                    error_code=answer.error_code,
                    error_message=answer.error_message,
                    entry_count=len(entries) if usable else 0,
                    token_estimate=(
                        sum(_token_estimate(e.text) for e in entries) if usable else 0
                    ),
                    included=usable,
                    read_ms=read_ms,
                )
            )
        if missing:
            return _failed(
                request,
                EnumContextPackFailure.REQUIRED_FACTOR_MISSING,
                "required tiers not resolved: "
                + ", ".join(
                    f"{t.factor.value}={t.status.value}"
                    for t in tiers
                    if t.factor in missing
                ),
                profile=profile,
                profile_content_hash=content_hash,
                tiers=tuple(tiers),
            )

        # Optional tiers that do not fit are dropped lowest precedence first.
        precedence = _precedence(profile)
        tier_tokens = {t.factor: t.token_estimate for t in tiers if t.included}
        excluded_by_budget: list[EnumContextFactor] = []
        optional_by_rank = sorted(
            (f for f in entries_by_factor if f not in required),
            key=lambda f: precedence.get(f, len(precedence)),
            reverse=True,
        )
        for factor in optional_by_rank:
            if sum(tier_tokens.values()) <= profile.token_budget:
                break
            excluded_by_budget.append(factor)
            del entries_by_factor[factor]
            del tier_tokens[factor]
        if excluded_by_budget:
            dropped = set(excluded_by_budget)
            tiers = [
                t.model_copy(update={"included": False}) if t.factor in dropped else t
                for t in tiers
            ]
        if sum(tier_tokens.values()) > profile.token_budget:
            selected = _select_required_tiers(
                entries_by_factor, profile.token_budget, frozenset(request.cited_refs)
            )
            if isinstance(selected, str):
                return _failed(
                    request,
                    EnumContextPackFailure.TOKEN_BUDGET_EXCEEDED,
                    selected,
                    profile=profile,
                    profile_content_hash=content_hash,
                    tiers=tuple(tiers),
                )
            tiers = [
                t.model_copy(
                    update={
                        "entry_count": len(selected[t.factor]),
                        "token_estimate": _tokens(selected[t.factor]),
                        "trimmed_entry_count": len(entries_by_factor[t.factor])
                        - len(selected[t.factor]),
                    }
                )
                if t.factor in selected
                else t
                for t in tiers
            ]
            entries_by_factor.update(selected)

        all_entries = [e for entries in entries_by_factor.values() for e in entries]
        if not all_entries:
            return _failed(
                request,
                EnumContextPackFailure.REQUIRED_FACTOR_MISSING,
                "no tier resolved any entry",
                profile=profile,
                profile_content_hash=content_hash,
                tiers=tuple(tiers),
            )
        generated_at = max(e.as_of for e in all_entries).isoformat()

        version_vector = [
            {
                "factor": t.factor.value,
                "status": t.status.value,
                "entries": [
                    [e.source_ref, e.text_sha256, e.as_of.isoformat()]
                    for e in entries_by_factor.get(t.factor, ())
                ],
            }
            for t in tiers
        ]
        version_vector_hash = _sha256(version_vector)
        builder_contract_hash = _file_sha256(_BUILDER_CONTRACT)
        implementation_identity = dict(sorted(self._implementation_identity().items()))
        candidate_id = str(
            uuid.uuid5(
                _CANDIDATE_NAMESPACE,
                _canonical(
                    {
                        "session_id": request.session_id,
                        "input_messages_hash": _sha256(
                            [
                                request.session_id,
                                request.newest_turn,
                                request.manifest_case,
                                # Present only when set, so a request without them
                                # keeps its candidate.
                                *(
                                    [
                                        {
                                            f.value: r
                                            for f, r in sorted(
                                                request.tier_revisions.items()
                                            )
                                        }
                                    ]
                                    if request.tier_revisions
                                    else []
                                ),
                                *(
                                    [sorted(request.cited_refs)]
                                    if request.cited_refs
                                    else []
                                ),
                            ]
                        ),
                        "version_vector_hash": version_vector_hash,
                        "caller_scope_hash": _sha256(
                            request.caller_scope.model_dump(mode="json")
                        ),
                        "profile_content_hash": _sha256(
                            [content_hash, request.token_budget_override]
                        ),
                        "sources_contract_hash": _sha256(
                            {
                                f.value: _source_identity(s)
                                for f, s in sorted(
                                    self._sources.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[0].value
                                )
                            }
                        ),
                        "reducer_version": REDUCER_VERSION,
                        "builder_contract_hash": builder_contract_hash,
                        "render_contract_hash": _sha256(
                            [
                                self._render_contract_version,
                                _file_sha256(_RENDER_CONTRACT),
                            ]
                        ),
                        "implementation_identity": implementation_identity,
                    }
                ),
            )
        )

        artifacts = tuple(
            ModelContextPackArtifact(
                factor=entry.factor,
                content=entry.text,
                token_estimate=_token_estimate(entry.text),
                provenance=_PROVENANCE.get(
                    entry.factor, EnumContextPackProvenance.OBSERVED
                ),
                source_artifact_hash=entry.text_sha256,
                source_contract_hash=builder_contract_hash,
                source_run_id=entry.source_ref,
                # The builder orders a factor's chunks by source_priority before its
                # hashes, so the position in the source result keeps source order.
                source_priority=position,
            )
            for entries in entries_by_factor.values()
            for position, entry in enumerate(entries)
        )
        built = self._builder.handle(
            ModelContextPackBuilderRequest(
                contract_hash=builder_contract_hash,
                generated_at=generated_at,
                profile=profile,
                artifacts=artifacts,
            )
        )
        if (
            built.status is not EnumContextPackBuilderStatus.OK
            or built.context_pack is None
            or built.pack_hash is None
        ):
            return _failed(
                request,
                built.failure_class or EnumContextPackFailure.INVALID_PROFILE,
                *built.errors,
                profile=profile,
                profile_content_hash=content_hash,
                tiers=tuple(tiers),
            )
        pack = built.context_pack
        assembly_hash = _assembly_hash(pack)

        refs = self._chunk_refs(entries_by_factor)
        unrecorded = entries_by_factor.get(
            EnumContextFactor.OPERATOR_WORDS_UNRECORDED, ()
        )
        rendered: ModelContextPackRenderResult = self._renderer.handle(
            ModelContextPackRenderRequest(
                pack=pack,
                chunk_refs=refs,
                identity=ModelContextPackRenderIdentity(
                    candidate_id=candidate_id,
                    assembly_hash=assembly_hash,
                    final_pack_hash=built.pack_hash,
                    version_vector_hash=version_vector_hash,
                    profile_name=request.profile_name,
                    unrecorded_prompt_count=len(unrecorded),
                    reviewed_prompt_count=0,
                    scrubbed_span_count=0,
                    transcript_extract_candidate_count=len(
                        entries_by_factor.get(EnumContextFactor.TRANSCRIPT_EXTRACTS, ())
                    ),
                    compact_route_identity=profile.summary_task_class
                    if EnumContextFactor.TAIL_SUMMARY in entries_by_factor
                    else None,
                ),
                carried_prompts=tuple(
                    ModelContextPackCarriedPrompt(
                        prompt_id=entry.source_ref or entry.text_sha256[:16],
                        capture_sequence=index,
                    )
                    for index, entry in enumerate(_unique_by_ref(unrecorded))
                ),
            )
        )
        if rendered.status is not EnumContextPackRenderStatus.OK:
            failed = _failed(
                request,
                EnumContextPackFailure.INVALID_PROFILE,
                *rendered.errors,
                profile=profile,
                profile_content_hash=content_hash,
                tiers=tuple(tiers),
            )
            return failed.model_copy(
                update={"render_failure_class": rendered.failure_class}
            )

        return ModelContextPackBuilt(
            status=EnumContextPackOrchestratorStatus.OK,
            profile_name=request.profile_name,
            profile_version=profile.profile_version,
            profile_content_hash=content_hash,
            task_kind=task_kind,
            candidate_id=candidate_id,
            assembly_hash=assembly_hash,
            final_pack_hash=built.pack_hash,
            body_hash=rendered.body_hash,
            stable_prefix_hash=rendered.stable_prefix_hash,
            version_vector_hash=version_vector_hash,
            generated_at=generated_at,
            messages=rendered.messages,
            factor_token_estimates={
                t.factor: t.token_estimate
                for t in tiers
                if t.factor in entries_by_factor
            },
            tier_statuses=tuple(tiers),
            excluded_by_budget=tuple(excluded_by_budget),
            implementation_identity=implementation_identity,
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _chunk_refs(
        entries_by_factor: Mapping[
            EnumContextFactor, tuple[ModelContextSourceEntry, ...]
        ],
    ) -> tuple[ModelContextPackRenderChunkRef, ...]:
        refs: dict[str, ModelContextPackRenderChunkRef] = {}
        for factor, entries in entries_by_factor.items():
            for entry in entries:
                chunk_id = compute_chunk_id(factor, entry.text)
                timestamp, lane = (
                    _ruling_ref(entry)
                    if factor is EnumContextFactor.OPERATOR_RULINGS
                    else (None, None)
                )
                refs.setdefault(
                    chunk_id,
                    ModelContextPackRenderChunkRef(
                        chunk_id=chunk_id,
                        source_identifier=entry.source_ref,
                        row_timestamp=timestamp,
                        row_lane=lane,
                    ),
                )
        return tuple(refs.values())


# Carried whole and verbatim: only an operator's review row removes a prompt (carry rule).
_NEVER_TRIMMED = frozenset({EnumContextFactor.OPERATOR_WORDS_UNRECORDED})


def _tokens(entries: tuple[ModelContextSourceEntry, ...]) -> int:
    return sum(_token_estimate(e.text) for e in entries)


def _is_cited(entry: ModelContextSourceEntry, cited: frozenset[str]) -> bool:
    if entry.source_ref is not None and entry.source_ref in cited:
        return True
    head = _ROW_HEAD.match(entry.text)
    return head is not None and head.group("ts") in cited


def _select_within_tier(
    factor: EnumContextFactor,
    entries: tuple[ModelContextSourceEntry, ...],
    budget: int,
    cited: frozenset[str],
) -> tuple[ModelContextSourceEntry, ...] | str:
    """Cited entries first, then the newest, whole entries only, to ``budget``.

    Returns the kept entries in source order, or the reason the tier cannot fit.
    """
    indexed = list(enumerate(entries))
    newest_first = sorted(
        indexed, key=lambda pair: (-pair[1].as_of.timestamp(), pair[0])
    )
    kept: set[int] = set()
    used = 0
    for index, entry in newest_first:
        if _is_cited(entry, cited):
            used += _token_estimate(entry.text)
            kept.add(index)
    if used > budget:
        return (
            f"{factor.value}: cited entries need {used} tokens, over the tier "
            f"budget {budget}"
        )
    for index, entry in newest_first:
        if index in kept:
            continue
        cost = _token_estimate(entry.text)
        if used + cost > budget:
            break
        used += cost
        kept.add(index)
    if not kept:
        return (
            f"{factor.value}: no entry fits the tier budget {budget} "
            f"(newest entry {_token_estimate(newest_first[0][1].text)} tokens)"
        )
    return tuple(entry for index, entry in indexed if index in kept)


def _select_required_tiers(
    entries_by_factor: Mapping[EnumContextFactor, tuple[ModelContextSourceEntry, ...]],
    budget: int,
    cited: frozenset[str],
) -> dict[EnumContextFactor, tuple[ModelContextSourceEntry, ...]] | str:
    """Charge cited entries first and share the uncited remainder equally, smallest first.

    Tiers that are never trimmed and cited entries of every trimmable tier are charged
    first. The uncited remainder is shared equally, smallest first. A tier within its
    share is kept whole, and every larger tier is selected inside that share.
    """
    fixed = sum(
        _tokens(entries)
        for factor, entries in entries_by_factor.items()
        if factor in _NEVER_TRIMMED
    )
    remaining = budget - fixed
    if remaining < 0:
        return (
            f"tiers carried whole need {fixed} tokens, over the budget {budget}: "
            + ", ".join(
                f.value for f in sorted(entries_by_factor) if f in _NEVER_TRIMMED
            )
        )
    cost = {
        factor: sum(_token_estimate(e.text) for e in entries if _is_cited(e, cited))
        for factor, entries in entries_by_factor.items()
        if factor not in _NEVER_TRIMMED
    }
    remaining -= sum(cost.values())
    if remaining < 0:
        return (
            f"cited entries need {fixed + sum(cost.values())} tokens, "
            f"over the budget {budget}: "
            + ", ".join(f.value for f in sorted(cost) if cost[f] > 0)
        )
    trimmable = sorted(
        cost,
        key=lambda f: (_tokens(entries_by_factor[f]) - cost[f], f.value),
    )
    selected: dict[EnumContextFactor, tuple[ModelContextSourceEntry, ...]] = {}
    for position, factor in enumerate(trimmable):
        entries = entries_by_factor[factor]
        share = remaining // (len(trimmable) - position)
        uncited = _tokens(entries) - cost[factor]
        if uncited <= share:
            remaining -= uncited
            continue
        chosen = _select_within_tier(factor, entries, cost[factor] + share, cited)
        if isinstance(chosen, str):
            return chosen
        selected[factor] = chosen
        remaining -= _tokens(chosen) - cost[factor]
    return selected


def _unique_by_ref(
    entries: tuple[ModelContextSourceEntry, ...],
) -> tuple[ModelContextSourceEntry, ...]:
    seen: set[str] = set()
    unique: list[ModelContextSourceEntry] = []
    for entry in entries:
        key = entry.source_ref or entry.text_sha256[:16]
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            unique.append(entry)
    return tuple(unique)


def _assembly_hash(pack: ModelContextPack) -> str:
    """The pack hash over the deterministic factors only (plan section 6, v6)."""
    dumped = pack.model_dump(mode="json")
    dumped["chunks"] = [
        chunk.model_dump(mode="json")
        for chunk in pack.chunks
        if chunk.factor not in _NON_DETERMINISTIC
    ]
    return _sha256(dumped)
```

```python
def load_tier_sources(
    contract_path: Path | None = None,
    *,
    resolve: Callable[[str], ProtocolContextTierSource] | None = None,
) -> dict[EnumContextFactor, ProtocolContextTierSource]:
    """Load factor bindings, sharing one handler instance per source node name."""
    path = (
        contract_path
        if contract_path is not None
        else Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "contract.yaml"
    )
    contract = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(contract, Mapping):
        raise ValueError("Tier source contract must be a mapping")
    block = contract.get("context_tier_sources", {})
    if not isinstance(block, Mapping) or not all(
        isinstance(key, str) and isinstance(value, str) for key, value in block.items()
    ):
        raise ValueError("context_tier_sources must be a mapping of str to str")
    sources: dict[EnumContextFactor, ProtocolContextTierSource] = {}
    nodes: dict[str, ProtocolContextTierSource] = {}
    for key, node_name in block.items():
        try:
            factor = EnumContextFactor(key)
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown context tier factor {key!r}") from exc
        if node_name not in nodes:
            if resolve is None:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Tier source {node_name!r} requires a runtime-injected port"
                )
            source = resolve(node_name)
            if not isinstance(source, ProtocolContextTierSource):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Tier source {node_name!r} must implement ProtocolContextTierSource"
                )
            nodes[node_name] = source
        sources[factor] = nodes[node_name]
    return sources
```

```python
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2025 OmniNode.ai Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""HandlerContextPackRender: ModelContextPack -> ordered role/text messages (OMN-21109, TA.7).

Pure and definition-B: ``handle(ModelContextPackRenderRequest) -> ModelContextPackRenderResult``,
no event envelope. The message order is fixed by plan section 4.6: the fixed legend, the
stable factors (plan section 4.2 rows 1 to 5), the volatile factors, the model-written
factors, then the identity trailer. Per-build values (candidate id, hashes, counts,
``generated_at``) appear in the trailer only; a stable block keeps its immutable source
identifier. The same request renders the same bytes.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json

from omnibase_core.enums.enum_context_factor import EnumContextFactor
from omnibase_core.models.pack.model_context_chunk import ModelContextChunk

from omnimarket.models.context_pack_render import (
    EnumContextPackRenderFailure,
    EnumContextPackRenderStatus,
    ModelContextPackRenderMessage,
    ModelContextPackRenderRequest,
    ModelContextPackRenderResult,
)

RENDER_CONTRACT_VERSION = "context-pack-render/1"
_ROLE = "user"

_LEDGER_ROW = "ledger row"
_OPERATOR_QUOTE = "operator quote"
_DOCUMENT_EXCERPT = "registry or document excerpt"
_OBSERVED_STATE = "observed state"
_VERIFIED_EXTRACT = "verified extract"
_MODEL_OUTPUT = "model output"

_PROVENANCE: dict[EnumContextFactor, str] = {
    EnumContextFactor.LANE_RULES: _DOCUMENT_EXCERPT,
    EnumContextFactor.INVARIANTS: _DOCUMENT_EXCERPT,
    EnumContextFactor.ADRS: _DOCUMENT_EXCERPT,
    EnumContextFactor.CANONICAL_SHAPES: _DOCUMENT_EXCERPT,
    EnumContextFactor.ARCHITECTURE_PATTERNS: _DOCUMENT_EXCERPT,
    EnumContextFactor.EXEMPLAR: _DOCUMENT_EXCERPT,
    EnumContextFactor.PLAN_EXCERPTS: _DOCUMENT_EXCERPT,
    EnumContextFactor.CLAUDE_MD: _DOCUMENT_EXCERPT,
    EnumContextFactor.OPERATOR_RULINGS: _LEDGER_ROW,
    EnumContextFactor.OPEN_WORK: _LEDGER_ROW,
    EnumContextFactor.OPERATOR_WORDS_UNRECORDED: _OPERATOR_QUOTE,
    EnumContextFactor.CONVERSATION_TAIL: _OPERATOR_QUOTE,
    EnumContextFactor.ORCHESTRATION_STATE: _OBSERVED_STATE,
    EnumContextFactor.REPO_STATE: _OBSERVED_STATE,
    EnumContextFactor.SESSION_GOAL: _OBSERVED_STATE,
    EnumContextFactor.CAPABILITY_DIGEST: _OBSERVED_STATE,
    EnumContextFactor.GOLDEN_CHAIN: _OBSERVED_STATE,
    EnumContextFactor.LOCAL_FAILURES: _OBSERVED_STATE,
    EnumContextFactor.TRANSCRIPT_EXTRACTS: _VERIFIED_EXTRACT,
    EnumContextFactor.TAIL_SUMMARY: _MODEL_OUTPUT,
}

# Plan section 4.2 rows 1 to 5: bytes depend only on the pinned commit and the selection.
_STABLE_FACTORS = frozenset(
    {
        EnumContextFactor.LANE_RULES,
        EnumContextFactor.INVARIANTS,
        EnumContextFactor.ADRS,
        EnumContextFactor.CANONICAL_SHAPES,
        EnumContextFactor.ARCHITECTURE_PATTERNS,
        EnumContextFactor.EXEMPLAR,
    }
)
_MODEL_WRITTEN_FACTORS = frozenset({EnumContextFactor.TAIL_SUMMARY})

_LEGEND = "\n".join(
    [
        f"Context pack, render contract {RENDER_CONTRACT_VERSION}.",
        "Each block opens with a header, [factor: provenance] and the block's source.",
        "Provenance labels:",
        f"- {_LEDGER_ROW}: a work-ledger row quoted in full, referenced by its "
        "timestamp and lane.",
        f"- {_OPERATOR_QUOTE}: operator words verbatim as captured.",
        f"- {_DOCUMENT_EXCERPT}: text copied verbatim from a pinned source and cited "
        "path@sha.",
        f"- {_OBSERVED_STATE}: state read from a system at a pinned point, not authored.",
        f"- {_VERIFIED_EXTRACT}: a span a model proposed and a deterministic verifier "
        "admitted as a verbatim quote of captured operator words; a candidate, never "
        "a ruling.",
        f"- {_MODEL_OUTPUT}: text a model wrote; not verbatim and not evidence.",
        "Blocks run stable first, then volatile, then model output. "
        "The last block is the identity trailer.",
    ]
)


def provenance_label(factor: EnumContextFactor) -> str | None:
    """The legend label of a factor, or None for a factor this renderer does not know."""
    return _PROVENANCE.get(factor)


def is_stable_factor(factor: EnumContextFactor) -> bool:
    """True for the factors that form the cached prefix."""
    return factor in _STABLE_FACTORS


def _hash_messages(messages: list[ModelContextPackRenderMessage]) -> str:
    raw = json.dumps(
        [m.model_dump() for m in messages],
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
        ensure_ascii=False,
    )
    return hashlib.sha256(raw.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def _failure(
    failure_class: EnumContextPackRenderFailure, error: str
) -> ModelContextPackRenderResult:
    return ModelContextPackRenderResult(
        status=EnumContextPackRenderStatus.FAILED,
        failure_class=failure_class,
        errors=(error,),
    )


class HandlerContextPackRender:
    """Render a ModelContextPack into the stable-first message list and its hashes."""

    def handle(
        self, request: ModelContextPackRenderRequest
    ) -> ModelContextPackRenderResult:
        refs = {ref.chunk_id: ref for ref in request.chunk_refs}
        pack_ids = {chunk.chunk_id for chunk in request.pack.chunks}
        strays = sorted(set(refs) - pack_ids)
        if strays:
            return _failure(
                EnumContextPackRenderFailure.UNKNOWN_CHUNK_REF,
                "chunk ref names no chunk of the pack: " + ", ".join(strays),
            )

        stable: list[ModelContextPackRenderMessage] = []
        volatile: list[ModelContextPackRenderMessage] = []
        model_written: list[ModelContextPackRenderMessage] = []
        for chunk in request.pack.chunks:
            label = provenance_label(chunk.factor)
            if label is None:
                return _failure(
                    EnumContextPackRenderFailure.UNCLASSIFIED_FACTOR,
                    f"factor {chunk.factor.value} has no provenance label",
                )
            ref = refs.get(chunk.chunk_id)
            if chunk.factor is EnumContextFactor.OPERATOR_RULINGS:
                if ref is None or ref.row_timestamp is None or ref.row_lane is None:
                    return _failure(
                        EnumContextPackRenderFailure.MISSING_RULING_REFERENCE,
                        f"ruling chunk {chunk.chunk_id} lacks its row timestamp or lane",
                    )
                source = f"{ref.row_timestamp} lane={ref.row_lane}"
            elif is_stable_factor(chunk.factor):
                if ref is None or ref.source_identifier is None:
                    return _failure(
                        EnumContextPackRenderFailure.MISSING_SOURCE_IDENTIFIER,
                        f"stable chunk {chunk.chunk_id} ({chunk.factor.value}) "
                        "lacks its source identifier",
                    )
                source = ref.source_identifier
            else:
                source = (
                    ref.source_identifier
                    if ref is not None and ref.source_identifier is not None
                    else chunk.source_artifact_hash
                )
            message = _block(chunk, label, source)
            if is_stable_factor(chunk.factor):
                stable.append(message)
            elif chunk.factor in _MODEL_WRITTEN_FACTORS:
                model_written.append(message)
            else:
                volatile.append(message)

        if model_written and request.identity.compact_route_identity is None:
            return _failure(
                EnumContextPackRenderFailure.MODEL_ROUTE_IDENTITY_MISSING,
                "the pack holds a model-written block and the identity names no route",
            )

        prefix = [_message(_LEGEND), *stable]
        messages = [*prefix, *volatile, *model_written, _message(_trailer(request))]
        return ModelContextPackRenderResult(
            status=EnumContextPackRenderStatus.OK,
            messages=tuple(messages),
            body_hash=_hash_messages(messages),
            stable_prefix_hash=_hash_messages(prefix),
            stable_prefix_message_count=len(prefix),
        )


def _message(text: str) -> ModelContextPackRenderMessage:
    return ModelContextPackRenderMessage(role=_ROLE, text=text)


def _block(
    chunk: ModelContextChunk, label: str, source: str
) -> ModelContextPackRenderMessage:
    return _message(f"[{chunk.factor.value}: {label}] {source}\n{chunk.content}")


def _trailer(request: ModelContextPackRenderRequest) -> str:
    identity = request.identity
    uncited = [
        prompt.prompt_id
        for prompt in sorted(
            request.carried_prompts, key=lambda p: (p.capture_sequence, p.prompt_id)
        )
        if not prompt.cited and not prompt.in_reviewed_range
    ]
    lines = [
        "identity trailer",
        f"candidate_id: {identity.candidate_id}",
        f"assembly_hash: {identity.assembly_hash}",
        f"final_pack_hash: {identity.final_pack_hash}",
        f"version_vector_hash: {identity.version_vector_hash}",
        f"profile: {identity.profile_name}@{request.pack.profile_version}",
        f"generated_at: {request.pack.generated_at}",
        f"unrecorded_prompts: {identity.unrecorded_prompt_count}",
        f"reviewed_prompts: {identity.reviewed_prompt_count}",
        f"scrubbed_spans: {identity.scrubbed_span_count}",
        f"transcript_extract_candidates: {identity.transcript_extract_candidate_count}",
    ]
    if any(chunk.factor in _MODEL_WRITTEN_FACTORS for chunk in request.pack.chunks):
        lines.append(f"compact_route: {identity.compact_route_identity}")
    lines.append("uncited_prompt_ids: " + (", ".join(uncited) if uncited else "none"))
    return "\n".join(lines)


__all__ = [
    "RENDER_CONTRACT_VERSION",
    "HandlerContextPackRender",
    "is_stable_factor",
    "provenance_label",
]
```
